senses.en: to try to get votes or opinions by talking to people

example.en: Volunteers canvassed the neighbourhood before the election.
example.zh: 志愿者在选举前到社区游说拉票。

senses.en: to discuss or examine thoroughly

example.en: The committee canvassed all the proposals carefully.
example.zh: 委员会仔细讨论了所有提案。

senses.en: a survey of public opinion

example.en: The canvass showed growing support for the plan.
example.zh: 民调显示对该计划的支持在增加。

senses.en: the written script of a film, including dialogue and scene descriptions

example.en: She spent two years writing the screenplay for the film.
example.zh: 她花了两年时间为这部电影写剧本。

senses.en: the state of not being enough or good enough

example.en: The report pointed out the inadequacy of the safety measures.
example.zh: 报告指出了安全措施的不足。

senses.en: lack of confidence in one's own ability

example.en: She struggled with feelings of inadequacy at her new job.
example.zh: 她在新工作中苦于自卑感。

senses.en: the period during which a person is alive

example.en: She traveled widely during her lifetime.
example.zh: 她一生中游历广泛。

senses.en: the length of time that something continues to exist or work

example.en: The battery has a limited lifetime.
example.zh: 这种电池的使用寿命有限。

senses.en: lasting for the whole of a person's life

example.en: The museum offered him a lifetime membership.
example.zh: 博物馆为他提供了终身会员资格。

senses.en: The act of making someone suffer because they have done something wrong.
senses.zh: 因做错事而使人受苦的行为；惩罚。

example.en: The judge imposed a punishment that fit the crime.
example.zh: 法官判处了与罪行相称的刑罚。

senses.en: A penalty given for breaking a rule or law.
senses.zh: 因违反规则或法律而受到的处罚。

example.en: The school uses detentions as punishments for repeated lateness.
example.zh: 学校把留校作为对反复迟到的处罚。

senses.en: the system by which a country's goods and services are produced and traded

example.en: The country's economy grew steadily last year.
example.zh: 该国经济去年稳步增长。

senses.en: careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste

example.en: We should practice economy in our use of water.
example.zh: 我们应节约用水。

senses.en: a formal discussion in which people express opposing views

example.en: The candidates will hold a debate on education policy.
example.zh: 候选人将就教育政策举行一场辩论。

senses.en: to discuss opposing views formally or argue about something

example.en: The committee debated the proposed budget for two hours.
example.zh: 委员会就拟议预算辩论了两个小时。

senses.en: to think carefully before deciding

example.en: She debated whether to accept the job offer.
example.zh: 她仔细考虑是否接受这份工作。

senses.en: relating to Africa or its people

example.en: She studies African history.
example.zh: 她研究非洲历史。

senses.en: a person from Africa

example.en: Many Africans speak more than one language.
example.zh: 许多非洲人会说不止一种语言。

senses.en: happening or done every day

example.en: She checks her email as part of her daily routine.
example.zh: 她每天查看电子邮件，这是她日常安排的一部分。

senses.en: every day

example.en: He walks to work daily.
example.zh: 他每天步行上班。

senses.en: a newspaper published every day

example.en: The local daily published a story about the new park.
example.zh: 当地日报刊登了一篇关于新公园的报道。

senses.en: A long narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck and tied in front.

example.en: He wore a blue tie to the interview.
example.zh: 他系着一条蓝色领带参加面试。

senses.en: To fasten or secure something with rope, string, or cord.

example.en: She tied the package with string.
example.zh: 她用绳子把包裹捆好。

senses.en: A result in which two competitors or teams have the same score.

example.en: The match ended in a tie.
example.zh: 比赛以平局结束。

senses.en: harm caused to something so that it is broken or less good

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
example.zh: 暴风雨对屋顶造成了严重损坏。

senses.en: to harm something or make it less good

example.en: Smoking can damage your lungs.
example.zh: 吸烟会损害你的肺。

senses.en: money that a court orders someone to pay for harm they caused

example.en: The court awarded damages to the injured worker.
example.zh: 法院判给受伤工人损害赔偿金。

senses.en: to examine or investigate something carefully

example.en: We need to explore all possible solutions before deciding.
example.zh: 我们需要在做出决定前探索所有可能的解决方案。

senses.en: to travel through an unfamiliar area to learn about it

example.en: They spent the day exploring the old town on foot.
example.zh: 他们花了一天时间步行探索这座老城。

senses.en: not correct or exact

example.en: The weather forecast was inaccurate, so we got caught in the rain.
example.zh: 天气预报不准确，所以我们淋了雨。

senses.en: when compared with something else; relatively

example.en: The weather this week is comparatively mild.
example.zh: 这周的天气相对温和。

senses.en: to combine separate things into one whole

example.en: The report synthesizes data from several studies.
example.zh: 这份报告综合了多项研究的数据。

senses.en: to produce a substance by chemical or biological processes

example.en: Scientists can synthesize insulin in the laboratory.
example.zh: 科学家可以在实验室中合成胰岛素。

senses.en: to soak or fill something completely with liquid

example.en: The heavy rain saturated the ground.
example.zh: 大雨浸透了地面。

senses.en: to fill something or a market completely so no more can be added

example.en: The company saturated the market with cheap products.
example.zh: 这家公司用廉价产品使市场达到饱和。

senses.en: (chemistry) to dissolve or combine a substance with the greatest possible amount of another

example.en: The solution is saturated with salt.
example.zh: 溶液中盐已达到饱和。

senses.en: to surprise someone very greatly

example.en: Her sudden resignation astonished everyone in the office.
example.zh: 她突然辞职让办公室里的每个人都大为惊讶。

senses.en: not having enough of something needed; lacking in amount or quality

example.en: His diet is deficient in iron and vitamins.
example.zh: 他的饮食缺乏铁和维生素。

senses.en: a person confined in a prison

example.en: The inmate was released after serving his sentence.
example.zh: 这名囚犯服刑期满后获释。

senses.en: a person living in an institution such as a hospital or mental facility
senses.zh: （医院、精神病院等机构的）被收容者；住院者

example.en: Visitors may only see the inmates during posted hours.
example.zh: 探视者只能在公布的时间内探望住院人员。

senses.en: in terms of culture

example.en: The two regions are culturally very different.
example.zh: 这两个地区在文化上差异很大。

senses.en: the act or process of ending or shutting something

example.en: The closing of the old factory left many people jobless.
example.zh: 老工厂的关闭使许多人失业。

senses.en: the final words or section of a letter, speech, or event

example.en: He ended the letter with a warm closing.
example.zh: 他以热情的结束语结束了信件。

senses.en: final or happening at the end

example.en: She gave a moving speech at the closing ceremony.
example.zh: 她在闭幕式上发表了一场感人的演讲。

senses.en: in or near the local area; within a limited region

example.en: The restaurant sources its vegetables locally.
example.zh: 这家餐厅在当地采购蔬菜。

senses.en: (medicine) affecting only a limited area of the body

example.en: The doctor applied the anesthetic locally.
example.zh: 医生进行了局部麻醉。

senses.en: a lack of fairness; an unfair act

example.en: They protested against the injustice of the decision.
example.zh: 他们抗议这一决定的不公正。

senses.en: an unfair act or situation

example.en: Sending an innocent person to prison is a terrible injustice.
example.zh: 把无辜的人送进监狱是极大的不公。

senses.en: a piece of paper showing that you have paid for something

example.en: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.
example.zh: 请保留收据，以备退货之需。

senses.en: the act of receiving something

example.en: We confirm receipt of your email.
example.zh: 我们确认已收到您的电子邮件。

senses.en: to change the normal shape of something, usually damaging it

example.en: The heat deformed the plastic frame.
example.zh: 高温使塑料框架变形了。

senses.en: a light silvery-white metal used in cans, foil and aircraft

example.en: The window frames are made of aluminium.
example.zh: 窗框是铝制的。

senses.en: as much as is needed; sufficient

example.en: We have enough food for everyone.
example.zh: 我们有足够的食物给每个人。

senses.en: to the necessary degree

example.en: She is old enough to drive.
example.zh: 她到可以开车的年龄了。

senses.en: an amount that is sufficient

example.en: I've had enough, thank you.
example.zh: 我吃饱了，谢谢。

senses.en: a thing made to look like or be identical to another thing

example.en: This painting is just a copy of the original.
example.zh: 这幅画只是原作的复制品。

senses.en: a single book, newspaper, or other publication of its kind

example.en: I bought a copy of today's newspaper.
example.zh: 我买了一份今天的报纸。

senses.en: to make something identical to another thing; to reproduce it

example.en: Please copy this file to the new folder.
example.zh: 请把这个文件复制到新文件夹。

senses.en: to do the same as someone else; to imitate

example.en: Children often copy their parents' behavior.
example.zh: 孩子常常模仿父母的行为。

senses.en: working or in use

example.en: The machine is in good operating condition.
example.zh: 这台机器的运行状况良好。

senses.en: relating to running a business or organization

example.en: The company reduced its operating costs.
example.zh: 公司降低了运营成本。

senses.en: present participle of operate: using or controlling a machine or system

example.en: She is operating the camera.
example.zh: 她正在操作摄像机。

senses.en: entertainment such as singing and dancing performed in a club or restaurant

example.en: The hotel offers dinner and a cabaret every night.
example.zh: 这家酒店每晚提供晚餐和卡巴莱歌舞表演。

senses.en: a club or restaurant providing such entertainment
senses.zh: 有歌舞表演的夜总会（或餐馆）

example.en: They spent the evening at a lively cabaret.
example.zh: 他们在一家热闹的卡巴莱夜总会度过了一晚。

senses.en: to walk or move unsteadily, as if about to fall

example.en: The toddler tottered across the room.
example.zh: 幼儿摇摇晃晃地穿过房间。

senses.en: to cover and pad furniture such as chairs and sofas with fabric
senses.zh: 为（家具）装垫子并包上面料

example.en: They upholstered the old sofa in blue fabric.
example.zh: 他们用蓝色布料为旧沙发做了软包。

senses.en: a sweet sugar-based coating spread on cakes

example.en: She spread pink frosting over the birthday cake.
example.zh: 她在生日蛋糕上抹了粉色糖霜。

senses.en: finely ground tobacco that is sniffed into the nose

example.en: In the 18th century many gentlemen took snuff.
example.zh: 18世纪许多绅士吸鼻烟。

senses.en: to put out a candle flame; to end something

example.en: The wind snuffed out the candles.
example.zh: 风吹灭了蜡烛。

senses.en: the burnt part of a candlewick

example.en: She trimmed the snuff from the candle wick.
example.zh: 她剪去了蜡烛芯上的烛花。

senses.en: to give attention to sound or to someone speaking

example.en: She listens to music while working.
example.zh: 她工作时听音乐。

senses.en: to take notice of advice or a request and act on it

example.en: He never listens to my advice.
example.zh: 他从不听我的建议。

senses.en: an act of listening to something, especially informally

example.en: Have a listen to this new song.
example.zh: 听听这首新歌。

senses.en: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building

example.en: They rented a small apartment near the station.
example.zh: 他们在车站附近租了一套小公寓。

senses.en: an informal word for father

example.en: My dad taught me how to ride a bike.
example.zh: 我爸爸教我骑自行车。

senses.en: a large area of water surrounded by land

example.en: We walked around the lake before breakfast.
example.zh: 早餐前我们绕着湖走了一圈。

senses.en: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used

example.en: The fire destroyed the old barn in minutes.
example.zh: 大火几分钟内就烧毁了那座旧谷仓。

senses.en: to ruin someone's plans, hopes, or confidence

example.en: The delay destroyed any chance of finishing on time.
example.zh: 这次延误彻底断送了按时完成的机会。

senses.en: to kill an animal, especially one that is sick or dangerous

example.en: Officials had to destroy the infected birds.
example.zh: 官员不得不扑杀受感染的禽鸟。

senses.en: the state of being physically or mentally unwell
senses.zh: 患病状态；身体或精神不适

example.en: Her illness kept her at home for a week.
example.zh: 她因病在家待了一周。

senses.en: a particular disease or health problem

example.en: He missed school because of a minor illness.
example.zh: 他因小病缺课。

senses.en: a stick of wax with a wick that is burned to give light

example.en: She lit a candle on the table.
example.zh: 她点亮了桌上的蜡烛。

senses.en: to check an egg by holding it against a light

example.en: The farmer candled the eggs to check for cracks.
example.zh: 农夫照蛋检查是否有裂纹。

senses.en: a place where roads or paths meet and cross

example.en: Turn left at the next intersection.
example.zh: 在下一个路口左转。

senses.en: a point where two or more lines or surfaces cross

example.en: The intersection of the two lines is marked with a dot.
example.zh: 两条线的交点用一个点标出。

senses.en: the set of elements shared by two or more sets

example.en: The intersection of the two sets contains only one number.
example.zh: 这两个集合的交集只包含一个数字。

senses.en: the act or state of overlapping or sharing features

example.en: Her work sits at the intersection of art and science.
example.zh: 她的工作处于艺术与科学的交汇处。

senses.en: a strong effect or influence

example.en: The new policy had a major impact on small businesses.
example.zh: 新政策对小企业产生了重大影响。

senses.en: a forceful hit or collision

example.en: The impact of the crash shattered the windshield.
example.zh: 撞击的冲击力震碎了挡风玻璃。

senses.en: to have a strong effect on something

example.en: Rising costs impacted the company's profits.
example.zh: 成本上升影响了公司的利润。

senses.en: to hit something with force

example.en: The ball impacted the wall and bounced back.
example.zh: 球撞到墙上弹了回来。

senses.en: a person chosen to represent others, especially at a meeting or conference

example.en: Each country sent a delegate to the conference.
example.zh: 每个国家都派了一名代表参加会议。

senses.en: to give part of your work or authority to someone else

example.en: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks to the team.
example.zh: 好的管理者懂得如何把任务委派给团队。

senses.en: the areas on the edge of a city or town

example.en: They live on the outskirts of the city.
example.zh: 他们住在市郊。

senses.en: to keep food or other things cold to preserve them

example.en: Refrigerate the leftovers within two hours.
example.zh: 剩菜请在两小时内冷藏。

senses.en: the grip of a wheel or shoe on a surface, from friction

example.en: The tires lost traction on the icy road.
example.zh: 轮胎在结冰的路面上失去了抓地力。

senses.en: the pulling of a limb or bone to align it during healing

example.en: The doctor applied traction to align the broken bone.
example.zh: 医生施以牵引来使骨折复位。

senses.en: support or acceptance of an idea, often in business or politics

example.en: The proposal is gaining traction among voters.
example.zh: 这项提议正获得越来越多选民的支持。

senses.en: impressive greatness or splendor

example.en: Tourists come to admire the grandeur of the palace.
example.zh: 游客们前来欣赏这座宫殿的宏伟。

senses.en: in an irregular or unpredictable way

example.en: The plane was flying erratically in the storm.
example.zh: 飞机在风暴中飞行得不稳定。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of mean; intended or signified
senses.zh: mean 的过去式和过去分词；意思是；打算

example.en: I never meant to hurt her feelings.
example.zh: 我从没打算伤害她的感情。

senses.en: an opening, hole, or gap

example.en: Light entered the room through a small aperture in the wall.
example.zh: 光线通过墙上的一个小孔进入房间。

senses.en: the opening in a camera lens that controls how much light enters

example.en: Adjust the aperture to let in less light.
example.zh: 调整光圈以减少进光量。

senses.en: a contagious viral illness that causes fever, aches, and coughing; the flu

example.en: She was absent from work for a week because of influenza.
example.zh: 她因流感缺勤了一周。

senses.en: shining too brightly

example.en: The glaring sun made the road hard to see.
example.zh: 刺眼的阳光让人很难看清路面。

senses.en: very obvious and bad
senses.zh: 显而易见的，严重的（错误等）

example.en: The report contains a glaring error.
example.zh: 这份报告有一个明显的错误。

senses.en: staring angrily (present participle of glare)

example.en: He stood there glaring at the referee.
example.zh: 他站在那儿怒视着裁判。

senses.en: feeling angry or bitter about something unfair

example.en: She felt resentful about doing all the work alone.
example.zh: 她对独自承担所有工作感到不满。

senses.en: relating to geology or the history of the Earth

example.en: The canyon formed over a long geologic time.
example.zh: 这道峡谷是在漫长的地质时期中形成的。

senses.en: devices that produce illumination, such as lamps

example.en: Please turn off the lights before you leave.
example.zh: 离开前请把灯关掉。

senses.en: visible natural displays of light, as in the northern lights

example.en: We watched the northern lights dance across the sky.
example.zh: 我们观看北极光在夜空中舞动。

senses.en: a radio or TV program where listeners take part by telephone
senses.zh: 听众来电参与的广播或电视节目

example.en: She called a phone-in show to ask about local traffic.
example.zh: 她拨打了一档听众来电节目，询问本地交通情况。
